summary: Completed testing of Printful Order Eligibility and Submit endpoints on Admin Orders page. All new features working correctly - eligibility endpoint returns proper 404 'not connected' response, submit endpoint returns proper 404 error, UI correctly displays unresolved items card with error reason, and Send to Printful button is correctly hidden when order not eligible. No regression in orders table load/view flow.

ui_bugs.issue: Order item selected_options displaying as 'undefined: undefined' instead of 'Size: Large • Color: Red'. The getDisplayOptionSummary function expects group_name/groupName and value_label/valueLabel but order items have name/value structure.
ui_bugs.selector: Order Items section in order detail dialog

action_items: Consider updating getDisplayOptionSummary in /app/frontend/src/lib/productOptions.js to also handle selected_options with {name, value} structure in addition to {group_name, value_label}
critical_code_review_comments: AdminOrders.jsx: fetchPrintfulEligibility correctly catches errors and stores them in eligibility state with unresolved_items array
AdminOrders.jsx: canShowSendToPrintful correctly checks eligible OR already_submitted before showing button
AdminOrders.jsx: sendToPrintfulDisabled logic correctly prevents button click when loading or not eligible
AdminOrders.jsx: data-testid attributes properly added for dialog title, unresolved card, unresolved list, and send button
printful_integration.py: get_printful_order_eligibility correctly returns 404 with 'Printful account not connected' when no OAuth connection
printful_integration.py: submit_order_to_printful correctly returns 404 with clear error message when not connected
printful_integration.py: _build_printful_order_items properly identifies unresolved items with specific reasons

context_for_next_testing_agent: Printful order endpoints tested when Printful OAuth not connected (expected state in preview env). When Printful IS connected, the eligibility endpoint should return eligible=true for orders with synced Printful products, and Send to Printful button should appear enabled.
